answer: Embodied Actuator Calibration Ledger. Each identity registers a physical actuator whose factory-measured tolerance signature is logged as a saffron-coded hash on a shared ledger. Enforcement: no two identities may share overlapping actuator signatures, since a single operator's hardware yields one fixed signature. Duplicate registrations are rejected at commit, forcing an attacker to acquire and calibrate separate physical units per identity. Residual variance is sampled from shale-embedded sensors during periodic challenge runs. Any lantern-tagged mismatch voids the identity.
